identity.canonicalName: Cordless glass saucer table lamp (unbranded factory design)

classification.verdictNote: No seller names a maker or designer. The same lamp is sold by at least eight online stores under different names.
classification.summary: The same 18 × 34 cm cordless lamp, with a clear glass saucer shade, ball finial, thin brass-tone stem and glossy enamel dome base, appears as the Oria, Marxel, Zaviera, Portia and Sorcha, among others. None of the sellers credits a designer or manufacturer. The look borrows from Memphis and Bauhaus styles, but we found no single designer original it copies.

specs.label: Materials
specs.value: Clear glass shade, metal stem and enamel-finish metal base

specs.label: Power
specs.value: Rechargeable; elegalight lists an 1800 mAh battery, 4-hour charge, up to 6 hours of light

specs.label: Colors
specs.value: Butter yellow, forest green, powder blue, pearl white, chestnut red, blush pink (elegalight's names)

match.basis: Reverse image search finds the same lamp at many stores; Ember Lamps' Oria lists the identical 18 × 34 cm size and materials

quality: A small cordless accent lamp: a clear glass saucer over an LED disc, a thin plated stem, and a glossy enamel dome base that holds the battery, switch and charging port. It gives soft mood light, not reading light.

Expect mass-produced quality that can vary between seller batches. Rechargeable lamps lose battery capacity over a few years, so check whether the battery can be replaced. Since the lamp is the same everywhere, the seller's return policy and warranty matter more than the name on the listing.

maker.name: unknown factory
paragraphs: No seller names the manufacturer. The same product photos, specs and color options across stores in the US, UK and elsewhere suggest one or a few overseas factories supplying many small online brands, which each rename and reprice the lamp.

elegalight, the store you found it on, is an online shop listing a Covent Garden, London address. Its page shows an impossible stock count and two different contact emails, so read its return terms before buying.

worth.line: Only at the lowest price: the same factory lamp sells under many names.

price.note: The identical lamp ranges from about $120 to over $200 depending on the label; buy the cheapest with good returns.

design.note: A stock factory design with no brand behind it.

materials.note: Real glass and enamel metal, but the built-in battery wears out over a few years.
